content: Sample report templates: CorrView International publishes a Full Sample Report of ultrasonic pipe testing (corrview.com, exact PDF URL moved); Maptrack offers free UT thickness report template recording readings/corrosion rates/remaining life; Sitemate publishes flexible NDT report template covering UT+PT (fetch blocked 403); US gov public-domain formats exist: PA DEP UST liner guidance Appendix B UT forms, NRC/Westinghouse UT thickness inspection attachments, BNL-68166 OSTI report. API Thickness Measurement Report Form exists but is copyrighted API corpus.
